newsitem.title: USA: WebTV sees Internet access about $20 monthly.
newsitem.headline: WebTV sees Internet access about $20 monthly.

text.p: WebTV Networks Inc will charge about $20 monthly for Internet access using televisions and low-priced set-top boxes being manufactured by Sony Corp and Philips Electronics NV, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
A detailed announcement of the price will come shortly, the spokesman said.
"From the beginning we knew the price would have to be near what ISP (Internet service providers) charge or what basic cable costs," WebTV spokesman Ian Yellin said.
ISP services connecting personal computers to the Internet typically charge around $20 a month for unlimited use.
Sony said on Monday it was advancing the launch date to September for its WebTV Internet Terminal because of strong demand from U.S. electronics retailers. The device has a list price of $350.
